title: Jest
definition: Jest is a delightful JavaScript Testing Framework maintained by Meta. It works perfectly with Node.js and Express to run your test suites, providing assertions (`expect`), mocking (`jest.fn()`), and code coverage reports out of the box.
simpleExplanation: Jest is a delightful JavaScript Testing Framework maintained by Meta.

answers.question: When should you avoid using Jest?
answers.answer: It depends on the specific architectural requirements and performance bottlenecks of your application. Overusing it can sometimes lead to tightly coupled code.
